name: SVG text boxes span the bundled font's ascender and descender
$comment: The top position (box top at y = 46.056) is free of the text's box only if the box ends 0.2 em below the baseline (44.056); with the descender of the bundled font (0.293 em, 47.776) it is blocked and the label goes right.

svg.source: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="120"><text x="100" y="36.056" font-size="40" text-anchor="middle">MMMM</text></svg>
